$comment: National strengths (domain/national-strengths/spec.md). Copied from national-strengths/config: heritage-rules.json (rules), levers.json (levers, scope_cost, where_values, units) and archetypes.json (archetypes); ages and their regions from event-tree/data/ages.yaml. Every number is a placeholder for tuning.

rules.$comment: Heritage system rules and balance. Every number is a placeholder for tuning; nothing here is taken from another game.

budget.$comment: Points a part may spend, from levers.json point costs. Small countries get a bonus so a county's birthright matters as much to it as an empire's does to the empire. size_class is the mean of the catalogue's size-dependent assessments (economic_strength, manpower_potential, military_capability, naval_capability, diplomatic_influence, trade_access) on very_low=1 .. very_high=5.

birthright.$comment_dormant: A birthright whose 'needs' condition fails (Venice without the lagoon, a steppe horde without pasture) goes dormant and wakes again when it holds.

heydays.$comment: A heyday wakes when its age is active and its 'wakes' condition holds. It sleeps while 'wakes' fails, and ends for good when its age ends or 'ends' holds. A heyday that ran 25 years in total leaves a mark: a permanent echo worth a third of its points (the 'mark' block, or its first lever at a third of its value).

counsel.$comment: Have the court read one ambition: it stirs at once and shows its warmth. Its words stay a hint; ambitions are never fully revealed while open.

ambitions.$comment_envoy: An envoy kept at a foreign court this many years learns the hint and warmth of one of that country's active ambitions, never its plain goal. The diplomacy design decides how envoys are stationed.

history_mode_setting.$comment: drawn: 3 drawn from the pool with one historical guaranteed. historical_only: only ambitions tagged historical. No setting reveals ambitions.

ambitions.$comment_legacies: A sixth legacy asks the player which one to let go.

warmth_bands.$comment: Share of the goal's leaf conditions that hold.

burden.$comment: A burden is a historical weakness. When its 'shed' condition holds, it is removed and its 'turned' legacy is granted.

inheritance.$comment: What happens to heritage when countries change hands.
inheritance.dormant_claim_wakes_if: owns the annexed country's capital and has held a majority of its homeland provinces for 30 years, and the annexed country's primary culture is accepted (culture design) or is the owner's own
inheritance.released_country: gets its own catalogue heritage, or the generated heritage of its archetype if it is not in the catalogue
inheritance.formed_country: keeps the forming country's birthright and legacies, gains the formed country's authored heritage if any, and draws ambitions from both pools
inheritance.subject: keeps its full heritage; an overlord's legacies never apply to subjects

ai.$comment: The AI treats its active ambitions (it always sees them) as goals with this weight next to its catalogue ai_personality priorities. An AI that completes one gets its legacy like a player.

units.pct: Percent change relative to the base rule (+10 = ten percent more). Negative means less.
units.steps: Whole steps on a ladder the owning design defines (harvest steps, loyalty steps, troop levels, road steps).
units.count: Whole things: envoys, officials, ships, rings, months, years.
units.flag: On or off; value is true. Names a rule switch or an access.

tax_reach_pct.meaning: Share of tax owed that reaches the treasury.

trade_balance_pct.meaning: Profit from wares sold, fees and tolls in the affected provinces.

toll_gold_pct.meaning: Gold per trader at your toll points (bridges, passes, straits).

loan_interest_pct.meaning: Yearly interest on your debt (negative is cheaper).

tribute_pct.meaning: Gold and grain your subjects and tributaries send.

loot_pct.meaning: Gold from sacks, raids and ransoms.

ware_output_pct.meaning: Loads made of one named ware (or all wares if no ware is given, at triple cost).

harvest_steps.meaning: Harvest rolls one step better (normal becomes good) on the affected food tiles.

herd_growth_pct.meaning: Yearly growth of herds; also softens drought losses by the same share.

store_rot_pct.meaning: Rot of local and castle stores (negative rots less).

castle_reach_rings.meaning: Rings of provinces each castle can feed.

migrants_pct.meaning: Share of refugees, craftsmen and scholars fleeing abroad who choose you.

class_slots_pct.meaning: Job slots of one class (seafolk, herders, market folk ...) in your buildings.

official_wage_pct.meaning: Yearly wage of officials (negative is cheaper).

official_type_pct.meaning: Strength of one official type's effect where assigned (a tax collector's +20 % becomes +30 % at +50).

official_years_to_full.meaning: Years an official needs to reach full effect (base 5; negative is faster).

official_capacity.meaning: Officials the government can support before strain.

lord_capacity.meaning: Named lords the government can support before strain.

lord_loyalty_start_steps.meaning: Lords start one step more loyal (wavering becomes loyal).

lord_loyalty_shield.meaning: One named cause no longer lowers lords' loyalty (for example 'new_ruler' or 'heavy_taxes').

grievance_shield.meaning: One named grievance does not count in the affected provinces.

days_to_capital_pct.meaning: Days to capital or seat (negative is closer).

integration_years_pct.meaning: Years before Foreign rule fades in conquered land (negative is faster).

troop_cap_share.meaning: Percentage points added to the troop cap share of royal provinces with an official (base 2).

levy_free_months.meaning: Months a levy serves before pay is due (base 3).

break_point_pct.meaning: Break point of the named kind or arm, in percentage points.

hits_pct.meaning: Hits dealt by the named arm (optionally only on the named ground).

march_days_pct.meaning: Days to cross (negative is faster), optionally only on the named ground.

forage_pct.meaning: Food your armies can take from the locals without causing Requisitioned.

siege_pct.meaning: Speed of your sieges (breaches and mining).

garrison_pct.meaning: Strength of garrisons on your walls.

hired_company_cost_pct.meaning: Pay of hired companies (negative is cheaper).

commander_style.meaning: Your commanders may take this style even before its inventions are known.

commander_skill.meaning: New commanders of the named origin start with this many extra points in the named skill.

ship_build_pct.meaning: Months to build ships (negative is faster).

crew_pct.meaning: Sailors raised per thousand seafolk in port provinces.

sea_days_pct.meaning: Days to cross a sea zone (negative is faster).

storm_loss_pct.meaning: Ships lost in storms (negative loses fewer).

trader_count.meaning: Extra trader units you can field.

trader_gain_pct.meaning: Value a trader collects each month on its route (land, river or sea).

traders_passing_pct.meaning: Traders passing through the affected provinces.

invention_cost_pct.meaning: Scholar-years an invention costs (negative is cheaper). Bough R1-R4 or a list of invention ids.

scholar_output_pct.meaning: Research made by each scholar and student.

spread_discount_cap.meaning: Percentage points added to the 60 % cap on spread discounts.

faith_shift_pct.meaning: Speed at which houses of worship and chaplains move the faith mix.

tongue_shift_pct.meaning: Speed of assimilation toward the ruler's tongue.

envoy_count.meaning: Envoys you can send at once.

opinion_steps.meaning: Opinion of the named group of countries toward you (same faith, same culture group, neighbours, a named country).

oath_fade_pct.meaning: Years before broken oaths fade (negative fades faster).

lands_taken_pct.meaning: How much each province you seize counts toward Lands taken (negative alarms neighbours less).

building_cost_pct.meaning: Gold and time for the named building (negative is cheaper).

building_unlock.meaning: The named building can be built before its invention is known.

invention_known.meaning: The named invention is known (granted once).

event_weight.meaning: Selection weight of the named event for this country (+100 doubles it).

event_option.meaning: Makes the named option available to this country (overrides the option's allowed test).

stat.meaning: Compatibility lever for the event tree's abstract stats (legitimacy, stability, prestige). Each unit costs the points set in heritage-rules.json stat_points.

homeland_resistance_pct.meaning: Years Foreign rule lasts in your homeland provinces while a conqueror holds them (+ is longer, which is good for you).

scope_cost.$comment: Cost multiplier for a scoped lever. Factors multiply; the result is never below 0.25.

path_hint.trade: A market history once fought over.

archetypes.$comment: Archetypes for generated heritage (national-strengths-design.md 6.1). detect: entity_type (catalogue classification), focus_any (ai_personality.economic_priorities.focus), modes_any (expansion.modes), seas (true = must have sea access, false = must not), rivers_min, naval_min (naval_capability level 1-5), size_min (size class), text_any (words in geography, economy and history text), region_any (catalogue region), religion_any (words in the main religion), mode (representation mode). Placeholders in text: {name} {capital} {goods} {sea} {river} {woods} {terrain_words}. Heyday age_options: first age whose regions cover the country is used. Effects are written for a size bonus of 0; percentages scale with the country's budget.
